senses.gloss:
गाढ adv.
 n. (-ढं) adj.
 mfn. (ढः-ढा-ढं)
 1. Excessive, much, very much,
heavy, oppressive, &c.
 2. Firm, strong.
 3. Hard.
 4. Close.
 E. गाह्
to agitate, affix क्त, deriv. irr.

गाढता f. (-ता)
 1. Firmness, hardness.
 2. Excess.
 E. गाढ, and तल affix;
also with त्व, गाढत्वं.

गाढमुष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Miserly, niggard, avaricious, close-fisted m.
(-ष्टिः) A scymitar, a large sacrificial knife.
 E. गाढ heavy or close,
and मुष्टि gripe.
